name: PER_ASSIGNMENT_NOTES
description: This stores notes related to each transaction performned.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_NOTE_ID
columns.description: This is a system generated primary key. Surrogate key.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the assignment to which the assignment note is assigned too. Foreign key to PER_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS_M.

columns.name: ASG_EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Identified the Effective Start Date on the Assignment to which this note is assigned too.

columns.name: ASG_EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Identified the Effective Sequence on the Assignment to which this note is assigned too.

columns.name: ASG_ACTION_OCCURRENCE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the action occurrence of the transaction

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifies person holding the assignment note. Foreign key to PER_PERSONS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: NOTES
columns.description: user specified notes related to the assignment transaction.
